empty.first_soon: The first one appears at the next capture.
empty.frame_failed: This frame could not be loaded.

error.no_camera: You need to pick a camera in the card configuration.

version_update: This card was updated to {v}. Reload to pick up the new version.

editor.title: Title
editor.overlay_right_hint: Values shown over the image are read at the moment you scrub to, not the current ones.
editor.overlay_left_hint: A second block on the other side of the picture. Leave it empty for one block on the right.
editor.name: Label

helper.camera_entity: Only cameras created by this integration have an archive to scrub.
helper.graph_hours: How much history the sparkline shows around the playhead.
helper.autoplay: Ignored when your system asks for reduced motion.
helper.deflicker: Evens out cloud-driven brightness jumps during playback. 0 turns it off.
helper.overlay_title: Shown above the readings. Leave empty for no heading.
helper.overlay_title_left: Shown above the readings. Leave empty for no heading.
helper.show_icon: Uses the entity's own icon from Home Assistant.
helper.show_sun: Shades the hours between sunset and sunrise on the graphs and the scrubber, using your Home Assistant location. Hidden when the bands get too fine to read.
helper.show_export: Adds an export button to the player bar. The video is rendered by Home Assistant and saved to the media folder.

error.export_running: An export is already running for this camera.
error.export_no_frames: There are no frames in that range.
error.export_bad_range: The end of the range is before its start.
error.export_low_disk: There is not enough free space in the media folder.
error.export_ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg was not found on this Home Assistant, so the video could not be encoded.
error.export_ffmpeg_failed: ffmpeg could not encode the video. The Home Assistant log has the details.
error.export_failed: The export failed. The Home Assistant log has the details.
error.entry_not_loaded: This camera is not loaded right now. Try again once it has started.
error.unknown: The export could not be started.

export.every_hint: The timelapse runs faster, the video gets shorter and the file smaller.
export.format_native: The video keeps the camera's shape.
export.format_same: Matches the camera's shape, so nothing is cropped.
export.format_crop: Only the camera picture is cropped. The date and readings are laid out again in the new shape. Drag the frame in the picture to move the crop.
export.soft_crop: This crop is only {v} pixels and looks soft on a phone. For a sharper video, pick a larger width under “Resize to” in the camera's settings.
export.sizes_hint: This format keeps its own sizes, so the readings stay legible on a phone.
export.size_estimate: Estimated: between {low} and {high}. A lot of movement in the picture makes the file larger.
export.low_disk: Only {v} is free in the media folder. Choose a shorter range or fewer frames.
